items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I disbanded and I turned my whole repertoire over to Eddy Beale.

ctx.x: And so I told him yes, I'd be glad to, But I had to disband my band in California. So I disbanded and I turned my whole repertoire over to Eddy Beale. And that's the last, I don't think Eddy ever did anything with that. That's the last, there went, Alice Blue Gown and all the other things that I had written.
So I left California by car and I got as far as Kansas City. That's when I ran into Basie. I ran into the Count.
